archimate:DataObject.name: UK GEMINI Spatial (Header)
archimate:DataObject.documentation:
Any payload containing geographical or land-based attributes must append UK GEMINI spatial tags:
spatialIdentifier: Authoritative Unique Property Reference Number (UPRN), Unique Street Reference Number (USRN), or Esri Global ID.
coordinateReferenceSystem: Standard CRS designation (defaulting to OSGB36 / EPSG:27700 for Great Britain National Grid).
spatialBoundingBox: Vector coordinates defining site extent boundaries.
